messages:
maria chen: Heads-up — console observability needs an owner for the new trace hooks + a retention policy decision for the User Request dashboard. Milestone: aim for 90d hot storage and 1y archive; prefer EOW if feasible. Who can take this?

alex ryan: @maria I can pick up hooks ownership for that dashboard view. Quick question — are we talking about span annotations + tags, or just ingestion-side hooks?

maria chen: annotations + span tags. Also want export/archival to S3 for the 1y archive. For the 90d hot retention, we need a trace-ingest config change (retention window). Can you take both?

kevin li: Infra note: S3 archive is fine. I'll need the bucket name and an IAM role from eng-platform to stitch. I can add a lifecycle rule and encryption. ETA Tue if you send details.

jessica park: To confirm product needs: 90d hot for quick debugging, 1y cold archive. Also need filter-by request_id on the dashboard. Is that supported today?

alex ryan: filter-by request_id works if services set a consistent span tag. Proposal: standardize on header 'x-rw-request-id' and map it to span.request_id. I'll open a tiny spec + decorator PR for services.

dustin wong: From SRE: please add an ingestion-lag alert (>= 2m) during the canary. I'll own the runbook updates and postmortem template if we see regressions.

alex ryan: Canary plan (short): 1) enable hooks on staging, 2) sample 5% of traffic, 3) validate span tags & request_id mapping, 4) confirm dashboard pane populates. I'll create PR for the trace-ingest config and dashboard panel.

deploy-bot: deploy started: dashboard-traces-service v1.12.0 -> staging

alex ryan: Deployed to staging, running smoke tests. @kevin need the bucket name to finish infra wiring for archive.

kevin li: Created S3 bucket 'redwood-obs-archive-2026' and put policy in #infra-ops. Shared ARN: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-obs-archive-2026

maria chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. @jessica I'll update roadmap with milestone 'trace-retention-2026-05' and link the PRs. If anyone hits blockers ping me here. :thumbsup:
